service.description: Create or change a purchase agreement (design NewAgreement, AgreementHeader, AgreementTerms). With no agreementId: a draft of the organization with the supplier at revision 1, the currency the buying policy's when empty; with templateAgreementId, a copy of the template's items, prices and terms in effect (never its releases). With an agreementId: the supplier, dates, currency, description and text; the terms (each new, changed, ended with a thruDate or, never approved, removed) and the signers and other parties (AgreementParty, removed with remove); or statusId to close (an active or expired one) or cancel it (a draft or active one, with a reason). A change of the supplier, dates, currency or a term counts the revision once with changeReason in the audit log, supersedes the earlier revisions' decisions and sends an active or submitted agreement to its approvers at the new revision. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses another organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a supplier it may not buy from (SUPPLIER_UNAVAILABLE), a template that is not one or another organization's (TEMPLATE_INVALID), no currency (CURRENCY_REQUIRED), dates out of order (DATE_INVALID), a change of a closed, expired or cancelled agreement (AGREEMENT_CLOSED), a supplier or currency change once released (SUPPLIER_CHANGE_RELEASED, CURRENCY_CHANGE_RELEASED), activation here (STATUS_INVALID), a cancel without a reason (REASON_REQUIRED) and a status the flow does not allow.

parameter.name: terms
parameter.description: Each term: agreementTermId (a change), termTypeEnumId, settlementTermId, termText, termNumber, agreementItemSeqId, fromDate, thruDate, remove

parameter.name: parties
parameter.description: Each signer or other party: partyId, roleTypeId (default AgreementSigner), remove

service.description: Add, change, end or remove an item of a draft or active purchase agreement (design AgreementItems, F10): its product, quantity cap and unit, value cap (amountCap, in the agreement's currency), release tolerance percent, dates and text, and its price (a ProductPrice row of the agreement and item, purchase direction: a new price ends the row in effect and starts the next, so the price as of a time stays readable). An item never approved and never released is removed with remove; any other is ended with a thruDate. A change counts the agreement's revision once, as store#PurchaseAgreement. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses another organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a closed agreement (AGREEMENT_CLOSED), an item not on it (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE), no product (PRODUCT_REQUIRED), a negative or zero amount (AMOUNT_INVALID), dates out of order (DATE_INVALID), a cap below what the item's releases use (CAP_BELOW_RELEASED), a product change once released (PRODUCT_CHANGE_RELEASED) and the removal of an approved or released item (ITEM_APPROVED).

Send a draft purchase agreement, or an active one whose changed revision waits, to the approvers of its step waiting (PurchaseOrderApproval, the agreement as source; the organization's purchase order policy steps for the agreement's value: its items' value caps, else their quantities at the agreement's price). Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses another organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a template (TEMPLATE_NO_APPROVAL), an agreement waiting for no approval (AGREEMENT_NOT_PENDING), one with no item (AGREEMENT_EMPTY) and a value no policy row covers (POLICY_MISSING).

A purchase agreement's balance (design AgreementList, AgreementReleases): whether it takes a release now and why not (a template, not active, expired by its status or date, or a change waiting for its approval); each item's quantity and value caps, tolerance, price, what its releases use (each release's quantity less its line's cancelled quantity, none once the order is cancelled or rejected) and what remains; and each release with its order and line, the agreement's revision, the line's ordered, cancelled and received quantities and its value. A template has no balance. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT, PURCHASE_APPROVE or PURCHASE_ORDER_APPROVE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses another organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Release a quantity of an active purchase agreement's item to a draft purchase order (design ReleaseAgreement): a new draft of the organization from the supplier in the agreement's currency (create#PurchaseOrder, with the facility given), or the draft given of the same organization, supplier and currency; its line (store#PurchaseOrderItem) at the agreement's price (get#ProductPrice with the agreement and item: the agreement's price row first) and the release allocation (AgreementRelease) with the agreement's revision and its time. The agreement is locked first, so two releases at once cannot exceed the caps together. Recurring releases are made the same way, each checked again. The same operation key answers the first result. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses another organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a template (TEMPLATE_NO_RELEASE), an expired agreement (AGREEMENT_EXPIRED), one not active (AGREEMENT_NOT_ACTIVE) or not started (AGREEMENT_NOT_STARTED), a changed revision not approved yet (AGREEMENT_CHANGE_PENDING), a revision that is not the current one (STALE_REVISION), an item not on it or not in effect (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE, ITEM_NOT_IN_EFFECT), no price (PRICE_UNAVAILABLE), a quantity or value over what remains beyond the item's tolerance (RELEASE_OVER_QUANTITY, RELEASE_OVER_VALUE), an order that is not such a draft (RELEASE_ORDER_INVALID) and what create#PurchaseOrder and store#PurchaseOrderItem refuse (SUPPLIER_BLOCKED, PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE).

parameter.name: orderId
parameter.description: A draft purchase order to add the line to; a new draft when empty

parameter.name: overCap
parameter.description: The release took the item past a cap, within its tolerance

service.description: A purchase agreement's print, now or as of a date and time read back from the audit log (its status, supplier, dates, currency and revision; each item's product, quantity, unit, value cap, tolerance and dates, with the price row in effect then; the terms; the releases made by then): its HTML, the revision then and the file name of its PDF. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT, PURCHASE_APPROVE or PURCHASE_ORDER_APPROVE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses another organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a time to come or not a time (DATE_INVALID) and a time before the agreement (AGREEMENT_NOT_YET).
The daily job (expire_PurchaseAgreements): each active purchase agreement past its thru date set Expired, each in its own transaction (one that fails is logged and the others go on). Its orders stay.
